document.title: ComatReleco Catalogue World of Relays (WoR) 3.2 (English)
document.pages: p.336 S3-B datasheet & fig.1 wiring diagram; p.335 11-pin socket index; p.332 socket/relay selection; pp.330-331 retaining-clip selection; p.382 accessory scope

modelingNotes: Exact order S3-B, ComatReleco WoR 3.2 p.336: '11-pin C3 Relay socket | Time Cubes compatible | screw terminal'. Rated load 10 A / 300 V; dielectric 2.5 kV rms/1 min; conductor 4 mm2/AWG12 single or 2x2.5 mm2; M3 Pozi screw at 0.7 Nm; TH35 (EN 60715) or back-panel mount; op. -40..60 C; 55 g; PA/PC; EN 60664-1. The catalogue is branded ComatReleco (Comat Releco AG); 'Releco' is the historical product brand and the source make.

Pinout from fig.1 wiring diagram, reviewed at 600 dpi. Bold value = socket screw-terminal marking (1-11); parenthetical = relay-pin IEC function on a plugged C3 (3 CO) relay: 1->11, 2->A1, 3->14, 4->12, 5->22, 6->21, 7->24, 8->32, 9->34, 10->A2, 11->31. Contact groups 1(11/12/14), 2(21/22/24), 3(31/32/34) plus coil A1/A2. Text extraction scrambled terminals 5/6; the rendered diagram gives 5=22, 6=21.

Bare socket = passive wiring base of 11 independent pins. C.n is the wire-side screw clamp; M.n is the relay-side mating contact; C.n and M.n are the two accessible ends of one internal conductor. Author one explicit fixed link C.n-M.n per pin to represent factory continuity; these are not field jumpers. The singleton bus functions and connector metadata do not themselves join nets.

No relay behavior belongs to this socket. The coil and three CO switches drawn in fig.1 are the plugged C3 relay, not the socket. There are no cross-pin jumpers, and installed relay contact positions are not permanent socket links. An 11-pin relay socket has no PE/bonding terminal; none is invented.

Ratings are equipment capability: current 10 A recorded per terminal; 300 V kept in notes (not authored as nominal_voltage) so the compiler does not read it as circuit intent; no AC/DC voltage_type is assigned to a socket rated for both. connectorPorts.MATE documents the relay-facing 11-pin interface keyed by IEC function; exact angular pin coordinates / keyway of the circular base are not specified and are not invented.

Accessories are separate orders and excluded from this type: included retaining clip S30-CM/10; optional retaining springs HF-32 / HF-33; coding ring S3-BC (p.382). Freewheeling-diode modules RD1/RD16 fit S3-M/S3-M0/S5-M, not S3-B. Do not substitute the 250 V S3-S or the S3-M(x)/EC-11 sockets. Installed hardware revision and any fitted coding ring are unverified.

connectionCoverage.notes: All 11 pins are inventoried as clamp (C.1-C.11) plus mating-contact (M.1-M.11) pairs with the visually verified screw<->relay-function map, and each pin has one fixed internal conductor (C.n-M.n). Open items are physical geometry (exact angular pin/keyway positions of the circular 11-pin base), the AC/DC split of the 10 A/300 V rating, and installed hardware revision; none of these is an additional electrical terminal. No PE/bond terminal exists on this relay socket.
